Hi Alice —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few notes from procurement to make the onboarding smooth: 

- For our PO process we require either (A) the PO number in the ACH/Wire remittance reference, or (B) a structured label in our invoice_reference field (format: RH-PO-{6digit}). If you can populate one of those consistently, our AP will auto-apply invoices.
- We can accept virtual-account identifiers in the remittance reference as long as the bank confirmation letter explicitly ties the virtual identifier to QuantaHealth legal entity and routing scheme.
- Our default for USD is to run a single micro-deposit to validate ownership. If you prefer to waive micro-deposits we need the bank letter + a 3rd-party confirmation (bank stamp or bank-signed PDF).

Looping in Jonas from PayOps to confirm technical mapping and any format requirements for the ACH CCD / Wire MT103 fields. Marissa — FYI on the PO labeling requirement; please log PO-4523 in the vendor folder when you process their onboarding checklist.

Next step: Jonas, can you confirm whether we need the bank confirmation to include the IBAN + virtual account mapping in a particular field, and whether payops can accept the signed letter in lieu of a micro-deposit?

Best,
Irene Choi
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QuantaHealth vendor activation - initial bank docs and question on virtual IBAN

Irene / Marissa —

Thanks. Quick PayOps rundown:

- For ACH (USD) we require either: the PO number in the NACHA addenda field (RDFI adds it to the CCD addenda) or the PO in our invoice_reference meta field. Example mapping we ingest: {"invoice_reference":"RH-PO-123456", "external_invoice":"QH-INV-2026-998"}. Please have QuantaHealth populate one of those.
- For EUR via virtual IBAN we accept the IBAN in the remittance_reference and we store an alias mapping back to the legal account. The bank confirmation must explicitly state the virtual IBAN is assigned to QuantaHealth and include a bank contact for verification.
- Micro-deposit: we can waive it if the bank letter includes bank contact + bank stamp AND you attach a recent bank statement (redacted) showing the legal name and the virtual account mapping. Otherwise we'll schedule a $0.01 micro-deposit verification.

I've attached a short onboarding checklist we share with vendors (payops_onboarding_checklist.pdf) — it lists file formats, expected fields for NACHA/MT103, and a sample CSV template for bulk remit mapping.

Action items for QuantaHealth:
1) Confirm whether you will supply a micro-deposit or provide the additional bank evidence (bank-stamped letter + recent statement).
2) Decide on which reference you will populate (we prefer RH-PO-{6digit} in invoice_reference).
3) Resend bank confirmation with explicit virtual IBAN mapping if applicable.

Jonas Weber
Senior Payments Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: payops_onboarding_checklist.pdf
